lines.say: Nobody alive can read this book. Nobody ever could.
There is a book that nobody on Earth can read.
Page after page of drawings of plants experts cannot identify.
And a writing no one has ever decoded.
It is real. Tests dated the parchment to the early fourteen hundreds.
It sits in a library at Yale.
Hoax, code, or lost language? Nobody has proved any answer.
What do you think it says?
